subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel/account-level heartbeat recipient contract for OK acknowledgments only, separate from alert/content delivery?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but adding public channel config changes compatibility, precedence, validation, and the boundary between agent heartbeat delivery and channel visibility.

options.title: Approve OK-only recipient config
options.body: Add a narrow `target`/`targets`-style channel or account heartbeat recipient shape that applies only to `HEARTBEAT_OK` acknowledgments and validates through WhatsApp account/allowlist policy.

options.title: Reject new config surface
options.body: Close the feature direction and document the existing choices: `showOk: false` for silence or agent-level `heartbeat.target` plus `to` when all heartbeat delivery should go to one recipient.

options.title: Defer to cross-channel design
options.body: Keep this issue as design input while maintainers choose a broader heartbeat recipient model rather than a WhatsApp-specific field.

recommendation.title: Approve OK-only recipient config
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `target`/`targets`-style channel or account heartbeat recipient shape that applies only to `HEARTBEAT_OK` acknowledgments and validates through WhatsApp account/allowlist policy.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the strongest combined signal from prior review context plus recent config/outbound routing history on the affected surfaces.
